Basis for Intervening:
On October 2, 2026, in Docket No. ER27-25-000, Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (“MISO”) filed proposed revisions to its Open Access Transmission, Energy and Operating Reserve Markets Tariff (“Tariff”) to establish a Large Load Addition Resource Study process. MISO requested an effective date of December 2, 2026, for these proposed Tariff revisions.

Michigan Public Power Agency (“MPPA”) is a Michigan municipal power agency and public body politic and corporate organized by its member municipalities under Michigan law. MPPA arranges for bulk power supply and transmission for its member municipal electric systems and is a Market Participant in MISO. As such, MPPA has direct and immediate interests in this proceeding that no other party can adequately represent, and intervention of MPPA is in the public interest. MPPA accordingly requests that the Commission grant this timely Motion to Intervene.
